一: One apple on one line. A single stroke means one.
二: Two lines, an apple on each: two.
三: Three shelves, an apple on each: three.
四: A box has four sides, so a box stands for four.
五: Five dots sit between the two bars, like five on a die.
六: Six friends squeeze under one small roof: six.
七: A knife cuts through the hook. Think of seven as the number with a slash through it.
八: Two strokes spread apart, because eight splits evenly in half.
九: A hand stretches as far as it can: nine, the last digit before ten.
十: Two hands press together and all ten fingers cross: ten.
百: One line on top of a white page full of dots: a hundred.
千: Add one small stroke to ten and the count jumps to a thousand.
万: Too many dots to count, so we call it ten thousand.
上: A short stroke sits above the line, and the arrow points up: above.
下: A short stroke hangs under the line, and the arrow points down: below.
中: A line runs straight through the middle of the box: in the middle, inside.
人: Two legs walking. That's a person.
今: A clock under a closing lid: this exact moment, now.
休: Tired out, a person leans against a tree to rest.
何: A person carries something odd and you ask: what is it?
先: A foot lands ahead of the person behind it: before, ahead.
入: The strokes point inward, like walking in through a doorway: enter.
円: A round coin inside a frame: the yen, a circle of money.
出: A foot climbs out over the mountain: exit, go out.
前: You stand at the front of the boat and point at what's in front.
北: Two people sit back to back, turning away from the cold wind of the north.
午: The sun stands directly over the upright stroke, so there's no shadow: noon.
半: A knife comes down the middle of a cow and cuts it in half.
南: A warm sun shines on a bell: the warm south.
友: Two hands reach out and clasp: friend.
右: Your right hand lifts food to your mouth.
左: Your left hand steadies the ruler while your right hand works.
名: It's dark in the evening, so you use your mouth to call out your name.
国: A border wall guards a treasure inside: a country.
土: A sprout grows from a mound of earth: soil.
外: The moon is out and someone stands under it: outside.
大: A person stretches arms and legs as wide as they go: big.
天: A line above a big person's head: the sky, the heavens.
女: A woman kneels with her arms folded across her lap.
子: A baby in swaddling, waving two little arms: child.
学: A child sits under the school roof to study.
小: A tiny stroke with two specks beside it: small.
山: Three peaks, the tallest in the middle: mountain.
川: Three lines of water running side by side: river.
年: A farmer carries home the wheat. One harvest marks one year.
後: Someone shuffles along the road, far behind the others: behind, later.
日: The sun, once round, squared off by brushes: sun and day.
時: The sun moves and the temple bell rings out the hours: time.
書: A hand grips a brush over paper: write.
月: A crescent moon with two lines of shadow: moon, and the month it measures.
木: A trunk, branches reaching out and roots spreading below: a tree.
本: A tree with a mark at its root: the origin, and books are where knowledge starts.
来: Wheat came to ancient China from far away: come.
東: The sun rises behind a tree. Face it and you're facing east.
校: Children mix together in a wooden building: school.
母: A woman holds her baby close, two dots of care in her arms: mother.
毎: Every person has a mother, every day of the calendar: every.
気: Steam rises from the rice, unseen but felt: spirit, energy in the air.
水: A stream runs down the middle while drops splash out both sides: water.
火: Flames leap from the logs, a spark flying off each side: fire.
父: Dad swings an axe, sparks flying from the blade: father.
生: A sprout breaks through the ground: life, birth.
男: Strength in the rice field: the man doing the heavy farm work.
白: A ray of sunlight so bright it looks white.
聞: An ear presses against a gate to hear what's inside.
行: A crossroads seen from above. Pick a road and go.
西: Birds fly back to the nest as the sun sets in the west.
見: A huge eye on two legs, walking around to see.
話: Words come out of the mouth and tongue: talk.
語: Words that I use every day: language.
読: Words on the page, spoken out from a book: read.
車: Look down on a cart: two wheels joined by one long axle: car.
金: Gold nuggets buried under a roof of earth: gold, and money.
長: An elder with very long hair flowing behind: long.
間: Sunlight slips through the gap between gate doors: space, interval.
雨: Drops fall from a cloud under the sky: rain.
電: Lightning strikes from a rain cloud: electricity.
食: A lid lifts off a bowl of rice. Time to eat.
高: A tower with a roof, windows and a gate, rising high: tall.
不: A line blocks the flower from growing up. Not this time.
世: Three tens joined make thirty years, one generation of people in the world.
主: A lamp flame burns over the person in charge of the house: master.
事: A hand raises the flag: time to do the job, the matter at hand.
京: A grand castle rises over the city: the capital.
仕: A person bows to serve their lord: attend, serve.
代: One person leaves the post and the next takes over: a new generation.
以: A person moves the load using a cart: by means of.
会: People gather under one roof and their talk rises like a cloud: meet.
住: A person is the master of their own house: live, dwell.
体: A person and a solid tree trunk, standing firm: the body.
作: A person with a box of materials, busy making something.
使: A boss points and a helper runs: use someone for the job.
借: A person holds a book that belongs to someone else: borrow.
元: A figure with a head at the top, where everything starts: origin.
兄: A big mouth on two legs: your older brother giving orders.
公: A sign in a tree-lined park: open to everyone, public.
写: A cover over the paper, tracing it line by line: copy.
冬: Slow feet trudge through the snow: winter.
切: An apple meets a knife: cut.
別: A knife slices between two people: separate.
力: An arm bent to show its muscle: power.
勉: Book in hand, you put in real strength: work hard.
動: It's heavy, so you need strength to move it.
医: The arrow goes in the box once a doctor has taken it out.
去: A person runs from the house and leaves it behind: gone.
口: A wide open mouth, drawn square.
古: An elder and a mouth: a story told for ten generations is old.
台: A nose over a mouth up on a stand, ready to speak: stand, platform.
同: Two matching people in one frame: the same.
味: Fruit in your mouth: taste, flavour.
品: Three boxes stacked on a shelf: goods.
員: A mouth to feed and a shell of pay: a staff member.
問: A mouth at the gate calls out a question.
図: A map drawn inside its border.
地: A road snakes across the earth: the ground.
堂: A temple on a raised platform of earth: a grand hall.
場: The sun rises over open ground: a place.
売: A samurai stands at the shop with goods to sell.
夏: You drag your feet under the blazing sun: summer.
夕: A sliver of moon comes out as the day ends: evening.
多: Slab after slab of meat piles up: many.
夜: The moon rises above the roof while everyone sleeps: night.
妹: A girl holding a small flower: your little sister.
姉: A grown woman shops for the family: your big sister.
始: She runs off the moment the flag drops: begin.
字: A child sits under a roof, practising characters.
安: A woman sits safe under her own roof, relaxed and at peace.
室: A bed under a roof: a room.
家: A pig under a roof: in old farmhouses, the pig meant home.
少: Slice a bit off something small, and there's even less: few.
屋: A house with an awning out front: a roof, a shop.
工: A carpenter's ruler, straight lines top and bottom: craft.
帰: Broom in hand, someone sweeps their way back home: return.
広: Arms stretched out under a huge roof: wide.
店: A little stall set up under an awning: shop.
度: A hand reads the thermometer: degrees.
建: A worker carries bricks up to the tower: build.
弟: Lined up by height, the shortest comes last: little brother.
強: A tiny bug pulls a giant bow: strong.
待: Stand on the road by the temple and wait.
心: A heart with drops of feeling around it.
思: A field of thoughts growing above your heart: think.
急: A hand grabs your heart and pulls you along: hurry!
悪: A ghost hiding in a dark heart: bad.
意: A bulb lights up over your heart: an idea.
手: An open hand, fingers spread across the wrist.
持: A hand carries an offering to the temple: hold.
教: A teacher points while a child sits and listens: teach.
文: A person with a pattern on their chest. Those first marks became writing.
料: Rice scooped with a dipper to work out the price: fee.
新: An axe bites into a tree, showing fresh wood: new.
方: A sign points the way: direction.
旅: Bag packed, you follow the flag on a trip.
族: Everyone gathers under one flag: a family, a tribe.
早: The sun rises over a sprout: early.
明: Sun and moon side by side: as bright as it gets.
映: The sun sits above the water and its light is reflected.
春: The sun wakes the flowers: spring.
昼: Measure the day and the sun is at its height: noon, daytime.
曜: A shining pheasant beside the sun: the days of the week are named after shining planets.
有: A hand holding meat: you have it.
服: Shirts on a rail, for every body: clothes.
朝: The sun climbs while the moon is still out: morning.
業: A worker's chart on the wall: business.
楽: Notes and bells ringing out: music, fun.
歌: An open mouth at a microphone: a song.
止: A footprint planted on the ground: stop.
正: A foot stops exactly on the line: correct.
歩: One foot, then the other: walk.
死: A bone beside a ghost: death.
注: A drop of water falls into the cup: pour.
洋: Sheep-white waves across the water: ocean.
海: Water full of fish: the sea.
漢: Water beside a castle: the Han river, which gave China its name.
牛: A cow's head from the front, with horns: cow.
物: A flag on a cow marks it as yours: a thing you own.
特: A prize cow at the temple: special.
犬: A big dog with a dot for its ear.
理: Polish jade and the grain inside shows why it looks that way: reason.
用: A sturdy frame, ready to be put to use.
田: A rice field cut into four neat plots.
町: A road runs through the fields and a town grows along it.
界: A flag between two fields marks the boundary of your world.
病: Lying in bed with a fever: sick.
発: The arrow leaves the bow: depart.
目: An eye turned on its side, the pupil in the middle.
真: Under the magnifying glass, it proves true.
着: Sheep's wool in view: time to wear a warm coat.
知: Knowledge shoots from the mouth like an arrow: know.
研: A stone grinds the gem until it shines: sharpen, polish.
社: A shrine on the soil, where the community met. Today, a company.
私: This grain is mine, close to my heart: I, private.
秋: Fire burns the stubble after the grain is cut: autumn.
究: Look inside the box with a magnifying glass: research.
空: A hole opens in the clouds: the empty sky.
立: A person with feet planted on the ground: stand.
答: A speech bubble fills in what's missing: answer.
紙: Threads pressed flat into a sheet: paper.
終: The thread runs out and the flag drops: the end.
習: A chick spreads its wings again and again, learning to fly.
考: An elder leans on a cane, deep in thought: think, consider.
者: An elder walking in the sun: someone.
肉: Ribs inside a slice of meat.
自: In Japan, you point at your nose to say myself.
英: A crowned hero rises from the grass: excellent. And, by sound, England.
茶: Leaves from a green plant, steeped in a cup: tea.
親: A parent climbs a tree to watch for the kids coming home.
言: Words rising from a mouth: say.
計: Count the dots out loud: measure, plan.
試: Words on a paper, under pressure: a test.
買: A bag of shells, the old money: buy.
貸: Hand over a book, and a shell comes back later: lend.
質: Axes test the shell to see how good it is: quality.
赤: A person glows beside the fire: red.
走: A person pumps their arms, feet flying: run.
起: The sun's up, so you jump out of bed: wake up.
足: A knee above, a foot below: leg.
転: A cart's wheels roll and turn.
近: The axe is just down the road, close enough to reach: near.
送: A box travels down the road: send.
通: Walk the road from one end and pass through.
週: The calendar goes round the road and comes back: a week.
運: A cart rolls down the road: carry.
道: A person walks along it, finding the way: road.
重: A person staggers under a huge weight: heavy.
野: Past the last house, nothing but grass: open fields.
銀: A pale metal beside the gold: silver.
院: A complete group of buildings on the hill: an institution.
集: Birds flock to one tree: gather.
青: A green sprout under the moon: blue-green.
音: A bell rings out notes: sound.
題: A question, and a person thinking it over: the topic.
風: A bug tumbles along, swept by the wind.
飯: A hand reaches for the bowl of rice: a meal.
飲: A cup at an open mouth: drink.
館: A castle-like building with food inside: a large hall.
駅: Riders once changed horses here. Now trains stop here: station.
験: A horse is timed against the clock: test, verify.
魚: A fish: head, scaly body, and four dots for a tail.
鳥: A bird with a head, body and tail, standing on four toes.
黒: Fire under the house turns everything sooty black.
